svg.text: Batch 20 · groups 63–66 · original v0.13 guide directions · awaiting feedback
Mirrored folded sweep + separate black dot
One continuous zigzag stroke, plus one separate dot tap.
The large black dot is artwork, not a start marker.
Mirrored upright stem and bent loop · 2 strokes
First descend along the near-vertical stem.
Then draw the detached bent loop from inner to outer.
Sweep around the first open curve, continue into the lower.
Finish with an inward spiral: no pen lift.
Start at the upper outer tip; fold through the center.
Continue into the lower return in one fluid motion.
● Blue = historic line start ○ White = line end · G023/G024 black dot requires a separate pen tap
